'''Yuko Mita''' (Japanese: '''三田ゆう子''' ''Mita Yuko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Mita was born on August 14, 1954 in {{wp|Setagaya}}, {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. Mita started her work during the [[Orange Islands]] saga. Her most notable roles is that of [[Gym Leader]] [[Clair]] and {{si|Kenny}}.
